description: Finish a video-blocks explainer or faceless-channel film (make_explainer) that STOPPED partway: a block the video model would not render, or a server restart. What it already made is kept (the script, the style key, the narration and every block that rendered), so this renders ONLY the missing blocks and re-assembles the same film, with the same topic, look, voice, length and options. It reserves credits only for what is missing and never charges again for what was kept. get_job and list_jobs show which jobs can be resumed and which blocks are kept. Quote it with dryRun first and tell the user the number. A finished film is not resumed: to redo one block of a finished film, use fix_beat with its job id.

dryRun.description: true = return the credits the resume reserves and render nothing

jobId.description: the id of the film that stopped (job_...), as get_job or list_jobs shows it

name: resume_job
title: Resume a stopped film
